# Three.js r180

Pinned `three@0.180.0` ES modules, served locally so the scene does not depend on a CDN.
Source: https://registry.npmjs.org/three/-/three-0.180.0.tgz
Included: `build/three.module.min.js`, `build/three.core.min.js`, and the upstream MIT license.

The neural engine has no dependency on Three.js. Only the articulated fly and escape arena use it.
